One  of  our  editors  were  looking  at  a 
 short  video  that  they  were  like, "Man,  I 
 really  thought  this  was  a  good  video." 
 And  it  totally  tanked.  It  got  like  4,000 
 views,  which  for  us  was  a  tank.  They 
 looked  at  it,  made  some  notes,  and  all 
 they  did  was  they  chopped  the  first  5 
 seconds.  Basically,  just  redid  the  first 
 5  seconds  of  the  video.  And  that  one 
 change  took  it  from  4,000  views  to 
 850,000  views.  With  that  one  change, 
 that's  a  200x  increase  from  one  change, 
 which  is  how  people  framed  the  value 
 that  they  were  about  to  consume.  If  the 
 first  5  seconds  is  what  immediately 
 sorts  80  90%  of  the  traffic  that  you 
 have,  then  isn't  it  crazy  that  we  don't 
 spend  more  time  testing  that  one  piece?
